name: Olmo Hybrid 7B
notes: Hybrid attention/SSM 7B from AI2. Card numbers are release-time and weak by 2026 standards (MMLU-Pro 14.47, BBH 19.88) - kept as an architecture data point, not a recommendation. Per-token KV geometry not published. KV basis: Only the 8 full_attention layers of 32 carry a per-token cache (layer_types: 8 full_attention, 24 linear_attention). 8 x 30 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 122,880 B/token (120.0 KiB). head_dim absent from config.json: hidden_size 3840 / 30 attention heads = 128, and the full-attention layers are MHA (num_key_value_heads 30 = num_attention_heads 30), so no GQA saving. The 24 linear-attention layers hold a fixed-size recurrent state (linear_key_head_dim 96, linear_value_head_dim 192) that does not grow with sequence length. Note config.json sets max_position_embeddings 65536, not the 4096 currently on this record. RELEASE DATE CORRECTED 2026-10-21: was 2025, now 2026 per the HF repo creation date (2026-01-28). The wrong year made every recency multiplier a no-op for this record.
